title: 第1040章 不言霜华中第1039章 不言霜华上
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
跪在地上的尸傀嘴唇张开，发出了那声她已经说了无数次的话——“默奴……谢主人恩典。”
沈不言死后第五年，慕清寒开始批量生产“沈不言”。
青岚宗外门有三十七个弟子欠沈不言人情。
这些弟子大部分根骨平庸、出身寒微、没有背景，是宗门里最边缘的底层。
沈不言帮过他们每一个人——有的帮她炼过丹，有的帮她打过杂，有的只是在她值班守夜时给她递过一杯热水。
沈不言记得每一个人的名字，在他们最需要帮助的时候伸过手，从来不图回报。
现在她死了，这些弟子成了无人庇护的孤雏，是修真界食物链最底端的存在，失踪了也不会有人追究。
慕清寒手持沈不言生前编写的“善行录”——那是温如玉被逐出师门前偷偷从沈不言遗物中抢救出来的一本旧账簿，封面已经磨破了，纸页泛黄，边角卷着毛边。
沈不言虽然嘴上说“帮人还要记账吗”，但温如玉硬逼着她至少记个大概，说万一哪天需要找人帮忙总得知道找谁。
沈不言被逼得没办法，就用最便宜的黄麻纸订了个小本子，每次帮了人就在上面潦草地记一笔。
字迹歪歪扭扭，有些地方还沾着丹药渣和茶水渍。
温如玉被逐出师门那天，把这本账簿塞进了自己的行囊里——这是她唯一从青岚宗带走的东西。
但她不知道的是，慕清寒早在沈不言死后第一天就用移花接木咒复制了这本账簿的内容。
每一笔记录、每一个名字、每一次恩情的细节，都在他的案头码得整整齐齐。
他从中挑选了七个最理想的候选者。
挑选标准不是修为，不是天赋，而是一个极其特殊的指标——“亏欠感”。
这七个弟子欠沈不言的人情最深，对她的感激最重，内心积压的“无法偿还”的愧疚感最浓。
在移花接木咒的因果图谱中，愧疚感是最容易被转化为服从性的情绪——因为愧疚的人会本能地寻求弥补的机会，而当弥补的对象从沈不言被替换成慕清寒时，他们的忠诚会变得极其廉价且极其牢固。
第一步，筛选。
他以“沈不言生前遗愿”为名，单独约见这七个弟子。

每个人都被告知同一句话——“不言最放心不下的就是你。
她临终前嘱托我，一定要替你铺好修炼之路。
从今天起，你跟着我。”
七个弟子感动得泪流满面，跪下磕头，口称“慕师兄大恩”。
没有人怀疑——因为慕清寒是三界公认的寒霜剑仙，是写《不言霜华》纪念故人的深情师兄，是花二十万灵石修金身雕像的慈善家。
他的话，谁会怀疑？
第二步，标记。
他以“特训”为名，将这七个弟子带到后山禁地的一处秘密洞府。
洞府建在沈不言死的那片乱石堆正下方，入口藏在一片被天劫劈断的枯木后面，被密密麻麻的藤蔓遮得严严实实。
洞府内部很宽敞，四壁嵌着暗绿色的灵灯，灯光幽暗而冰冷，照得每个人的脸都泛出一层病态的青灰色。
他让每个弟子服下一颗“洗髓丹”——丹是货真价实的上品洗髓丹，但每一颗丹药内部都被他以微雕之术刻入了一枚锁魂铃子铃。
子铃入体后不会立刻激活，而是潜伏在丹田深处，等待母铃的召唤。
弟子们服下丹药后只觉得丹田暖洋洋的，修为瓶颈隐隐松动，个个欣喜若狂，对慕清寒千恩万谢。
他们不知道自己的丹田核心已经被种下了一颗肉眼看不见的铃种，铃种表面蔓延出数十条极细的魔纹触须，像榕树的气根一样沿着经脉向四肢百骸缓缓延伸，每一条触须的末端都卷曲成铃舌的形状。
第三步，收割。
一个月后的某个深夜，母铃摇响。
七个弟子同时停止了呼吸。
他们正在各自打坐修炼——有人在自己的宿舍里，有人在后山闭关的岩洞中，有人在丹药房值夜——在毫无征兆的瞬间，心脏像被人猛地攥住了一样骤然停跳。
没有挣扎，没有惨叫，没有惊动任何人。
他们的魂魄在三息之内被锁魂铃子铃吞食，和当年的沈不言一模一样。

他们的尸体在第二天被人发现，死因诊断为“修炼走火入魔，心脉逆行而亡”——这在修真界太常见了，每年都有底层弟子因为功法出错暴毙，连调查都省了。
他们的尸体被秘密运回后山禁地的洞府中。
接下来的七天，慕清寒逐一将他们炼成尸傀。
content_en:
The corpse puppet kneeling on the ground opened its lips and uttered the words she had said countless times - "Monu... thank you Master for your grace."
In the fifth year after Shen Buyan's death, Mu Qinghan began mass production of "Shen Buyan".
There are thirty-seven disciples in the outer sect of Qinglan Sect.
Most of these disciples have mediocre abilities, humble backgrounds, and no background. They are the most marginalized members of the sect.
Shen Buyan had helped each of them - some helped her refine elixirs, some helped her with chores, and some just handed her a glass of hot water when she was on duty at night.
Shen Buyan remembered everyone's name and reached out to them when they needed help most, never expecting anything in return.
Now that she is dead, these disciples have become orphans with no one to protect them. They are at the bottom of the food chain in the world of cultivation. No one will investigate them if they disappear.
Mu Qinghan held the "Record of Good Deeds" written by Shen Buyan during his lifetime - it was an old account book that Wen Ruyu secretly rescued from Shen Buyan's belongings before she was expelled from the school. The cover was frayed, the pages were yellowed, and the corners were curled.
Although Shen Buyan said, "Do you still need to keep accounts when helping others?", Wen Ruyu forced her to at least keep a rough idea, saying that if she needed help one day, she must know who to call.
Shen Buyan was forced to do nothing, so he made a small book with the cheapest jute paper, and scribbled something in it every time he helped someone.
The handwriting is crooked, and there are still pill residues and tea stains in some places.
On the day Wen Ruyu was expelled from the school, she stuffed this account book into her luggage - it was the only thing she took away from the Qinglan Sect.
But what she didn't know was that Mu Qinghan had copied the contents of this account book using the Replacement Curse as early as the first day after Shen Buyan's death.
Every record, every name, every detail of kindness is neatly listed on his desk.
He selected seven of the most ideal candidates.
The selection criterion is not cultivation or talent, but an extremely special indicator - "sense of indebtedness".
These seven disciples owed Shen Wuyan the deepest favor, were most grateful to her, and had the strongest sense of "unable to repay" guilt in their hearts.
In the causal diagram of the transfer curse, guilt is the emotion that is most easily transformed into obedience - because guilty people will instinctively seek opportunities to make amends, and when the object of compensation is replaced from Shen Buyan to Mu Qinghan, their loyalty will become extremely cheap and extremely strong.
The first step is screening.
In the name of "Shen Buyan's last wish", he met with these seven disciples alone.
Everyone was told the same sentence - "The person who worries most if you don't say anything is you.
Before she died, she told me that I must pave the way for you to cultivate.
From today on, you follow me. "
The seven disciples were so moved that they burst into tears. They knelt down and kowtowed, saying, "I admire the great kindness of my senior brother."
No one doubts it - because Mu Qinghan is the Frost Sword Immortal recognized by the three worlds, the affectionate senior brother who wrote "Speechless Frost Flower" to commemorate his deceased friend, and the philanthropist who spent 200,000 spiritual stones to build a golden statue.
Who would doubt his words?
The second step is marking.
In the name of "special training", he took these seven disciples to a secret cave in the forbidden area of ​​​​the back mountain.
The cave was built directly under the pile of rocks where Shen Buyan died. The entrance was hidden behind a piece of dead wood that had been chopped off by a catastrophe, and was tightly covered by dense vines.
The interior of the cave is very spacious, with dark green spiritual lamps embedded in the walls. The light is dim and cold, making everyone's face glow with a sickly blue-gray color.
He asked each of his disciples to take a "Marrow Cleansing Pill" - the pill was a genuine high-grade Marrow Cleansing Pill, but inside each pill he carved a soul-locking bell using micro-carving techniques.
The child bell will not be activated immediately after entering the body, but will lurk deep in the Dantian, waiting for the call of the mother bell.
After taking the elixir, the disciples only felt warm in their Dantian, and their cultivation bottlenecks were faintly loosened. They were all overjoyed and thanked Mu Qinghan profusely..
They didn't know that an invisible bell seed had been planted in the core of their Dantian. Dozens of extremely fine magic pattern tentacles spread out from the surface of the bell seed, extending slowly along the meridians to the limbs like the aerial roots of a banyan tree. The end of each tentacle was curled into the shape of a bell tongue.
The third step is harvesting.
One month later, late one night, the mother bell rang.
The seven disciples stopped breathing at the same time.
They were meditating and practicing separately - some were in their own dormitories, some were in the caves of retreat in the back mountains, and some were on duty at the elixir house - at an instant without warning, their hearts suddenly stopped beating as if someone had suddenly grasped them.
There was no struggling, no screaming, and no one was alarmed.
Their souls were devoured by Soul Suo Ling Zi Ling within three breaths, exactly like Shen Buyan back then.
Their bodies were discovered the next day, and the cause of death was diagnosed as "the practice went too far, and the heart veins went retrograde and died" - this is too common in the world of cultivation. Every year, low-level disciples die suddenly because of errors in the practice, and even investigation is omitted.
Their bodies were secretly transported back to the cave in the forbidden area of ​​​​the back mountain.
In the next seven days, Mu Qinghan transformed them into corpse puppets one by one.
